content.title: About
content.content: Soft Drink "Pepper" is a non‑alcoholic carbonated beverage with a subtle chili pepper heat. It combines the sweetness of sugar, citrus aromatics, and a characteristic spicy note, creating a unique flavor profile. The drink is made from water, sugar, natural flavorings, chili extract, and carbon dioxide.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The first pepper‑flavored soda was launched in Japan in the early 2000s.
Chili heat is measured on the Scoville scale; the drink typically uses extract rated 500–800 Scoville units, giving a mild yet noticeable kick.
Chili in the drink is considered a natural metabolism stimulant.
It is often served in cocktails as a substitute for traditional bitters.
Carbonation softens the perception of heat compared to pure chili sauce.

items.title: Metabolism boost
items.content: Capsaicin, the active component of chili, can increase thermogenesis, helping the body burn more calories.

items.title: Antioxidant protection
items.content: The beverage contains vitamin C and polyphenols that help neutralize free radicals.

items.title: Improved digestion
items.content: Mild spiciness stimulates gastric juice production, aiding nutrient absorption.

items.title: Mood enhancement
items.content: Capsaicin may trigger endorphin release, creating a mild sense of well‑being.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: Like any carbonated drink, it contributes to the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Sensitivity to spice
items.content: People with a low tolerance for heat or with gastritis should consume the drink in moderation.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: The soda contains sugar, so individuals with diabetes or those monitoring calorie intake should limit consumption.

items.title: Carbonation
items.content: Carbon dioxide can cause bloating in some individuals.

items.title: Chili allergy
items.content: Rarely, an allergic reaction to chili components may occur.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve Soft Drink "Pepper" chilled over ice. It can be used as a base for cocktails, mixed with fruit juices, or added to meat marinades for a gentle heat.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, keep refrigerated and consume within 3–5 days.
